email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Concrete Panel Detailer / Draftsperson advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, where I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert says you will train people without panel detailing experience and that the role suits new graduates. I use AutoCAD in 2D and 3D, and I modelled a footing and column in 3D in AutoCAD during my course. My drafting is from study rather than paid work, and I have not used Tekla yet.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short chat about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I saw your SEEK advert for a Concrete Panel Detailer / Draftsperson in Melbourne's northern suburbs, and I would like to be considered. Your advert says you will train people new to panel detailing and asks for AutoCAD and the ability to picture a building in 3D from 2D drawings, which is the kind of work I want to build a career in.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, where I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I use AutoCAD in 2D and 3D, modelled a footing and column in 3D in AutoCAD, and modelled a pedestrian truss bridge in Revit. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements to cut down on errors and rework, and kept site reports and progress records.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My drafting is from study rather than paid production work and I have not used Tekla yet, so I would start at entry level and learn your detailing methods.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the role.
